meta.title: Cleanup item lifecycle and receipt reconciliation

states.label: partial
states.sublabel: no item cancelled or left started

cards.title: Reading the diagram
items: Per item: planned, started, moved, skippedStale, failed, cancelled. Per receipt: complete, partial, interrupted, needsAttention. History level: Admission, reviewRequired, Pruned, Quarantined
Admission, Pruned and Quarantined are not enum states; quarantine is the isQuarantined flag
A dashed arrow is allowed by the reducer but not produced in v1
Arrows into complete, partial and Pruned carry no label: the condition written on the target applies to every arrow into it
moved leads to complete only when every item moved; a run that mixes moved items with skipped or failed ones ends partial

cards.title: Reducer guards
items: Replays the persisted log onto items seeded as planned from the intent
A terminal on a planned item is terminalBeforeStart
A second .started is duplicateStart; a second terminal is duplicateTerminal
A terminal earlier than startedAt is invalidTimeOrder; an unlisted item is unknownItem
Any rejection quarantines the whole receipt as needsAttention

cards.title: Reconciliation
items: Runs at the end of each run and on every history load, at observedAt
Items still planned become cancelled, so the receipt is interrupted
An item left started with no terminal makes the receipt needsAttention
It only reduces records: executionCalls is always 0, so no move is repeated
Its result is only complete, partial, interrupted or needsAttention; planned and inProgress exist only inside the reducer

cards.title: Retention and admission
items: Unresolved means needsAttention or quarantined, plus each unreadable record
An unreadable record (including a newer schema) is counted but never listed in history
A new run is admitted only while unresolved < 50 (maximumUnresolvedCount); otherwise reviewRequired
After each run that finishes recording, complete, partial and interrupted receipts older than 90 days are deleted, then the oldest beyond 500; a pruning failure is ignored
Unresolved receipts are never pruned and stay counted against admission
Unresolved is permanent in v1: deleteReceipts has no caller in the app, so once the limit is reached every run is refused with no in-app recovery
A failed intent write can leave an empty receipt folder, which loads as unreadable

cards.title: Run state in AdaptiveTrustSession
items: complete maps to .complete, interrupted to .interrupted, any other aggregate to .partial
A history failure after at least one recorded outcome reports .partial and .receiptIncomplete
A failure before any outcome (busy, reviewRequired, intent write) is a refusal with no run state
The user sees busy and reviewRequired as .historyBusy and .reviewRequired; other history errors as .receiptHistoryUnavailable
